question: The angle subtended by an arc at the center is 72°, and its length is 22 cm. Find the radius of the circle.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The radius of a circle can be calculated directly using the arc length (l) and central angle (θ): r = (l × 360°) ÷ (θ × 2π)

⇒ r = (22 × 360) ÷ (72 × 2 × 22/7)

⇒ r = (360 × 7) ÷ (72 × 2)

⇒ r = (5 × 7) ÷ 2 = 35 ÷ 2

⇒ r = 17.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 17.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Arc length (l) = 22 cm

Central angle (θ) = 72°

**Formula Used:**

Length of an arc = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr

**Calculations:**

⇒ 22 = (72° ÷ 360°) × 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × r

⇒ 22 = (1 ÷ 5) × (44 ÷ 7) × r

Dividing both sides by 22:

⇒ 1 = (1 ÷ 5) × (2 ÷ 7) × r

⇒ 1 = (2 ÷ 35) × r

⇒ r = 35 ÷ 2

⇒ r = 17.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 17.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area of a sector of a circle with central angle θ is given by A = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr². Alternatively, if the arc length (l) is known, the area can be calculated as A = (1 ÷ 2) × l × r.

Radian Measure

When the central angle θ is measured in radians, the formula for the arc length simplifies to l = r × θ. Note that 180° is equal to π radians.

Circumference and Area of Circle

The total boundary length (circumference) of a complete circle is 2πr, corresponding to an angle of 360°. The total area enclosed by the circle is πr².
